issues: Year is not printed anywhere in the catalog. It is a single district-wide Quarry Valley Program of Studies shared by Poultney, Proctor and West Rutland high schools; courses are tagged by school (PrHS, WRS, PoHS; e.g. 38 PrHS-only, 20 all three), so Phase 2 must filter to courses tagged PrHS. Evidence it is older than 2026-27: (1) it shows a two-tier graduation table ('Current' vs 'Class of 2027 and Beyond'), while the PrHS Handbook 26-27 lists only the new requirements as 'Current'; in 2026-27 every HS student is Class of 2027+; (2) the PDF was rendered by Google Docs renderer m141 (about Oct 2025), the 26-27 handbook by m154; (3) it gives Proctor's old URL phs.grcsu.org. Most likely the 2025-26 catalog, still the only one linked on the Proctor site; human check suggested. The 2026-27 handbook is saved as the current grad-requirements source. Other Quarry Valley schools (Poultney, West Rutland) probably link the same file.
